notes: Authoritative SOP for front-end behavior. Read-only at runtime.
Avoid page-local mobile navigation scripts/CSS; handled by template assets.
Hamburger breakpoint is <= 766px across the site.
CSS formatting: use exactly one blank line between selector blocks (e.g., exercises.css, demo.css).
Codex pages: do not include style.min.css; QA accordion is SSOT via qa-accordion.css.
base.css is SSOT for common page defaults (typography, links, media, tables, utilities).
Specialized CSS (exercises.css, lists.css, lessons.css) should only contain page/system-specific rules.
